title: The AI Revolution Nobody Is Prepared For in 2026
angle: By 2026, AI won't replace jobs gradually — it will collapse entire industries in a single quarterly earnings cycle, and most people are sleepwalking into it.

scenes.voiceover: In 2026, millions of people will wake up and realize their career no longer exists. Not declining. Gone.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. Bold white text slams in word by word. Final word GONE flashes red. Rapid zoom pulse on each word.
scenes.caption_overlay: This already started. You just haven't felt it yet.

scenes.voiceover: Goldman Sachs said 300 million jobs. But that number is already outdated. The new models are 10x faster than projected.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts: Goldman Sachs report headline, empty office floors, server farms glowing at night, stock ticker crashing. Each cut under 1.5s.
scenes.caption_overlay: The forecast was wrong. It's worse.

scenes.voiceover: Legal. Accounting. Radiology. Software engineering. These aren't at risk — they're already being restructured right now.
scenes.visual_description: Industry names appear one by one with a red X slashing through each. Camera shake on every X. White background for contrast shock.
scenes.caption_overlay: Your degree didn't come with an expiration date. Until now.

scenes.voiceover: 2023: ChatGPT shocks the world. 2024: Agents arrive. 2025: Workflows automate. 2026: The invoices stop coming.
scenes.visual_description: Minimalist timeline graphic animates left to right. Each year pulses in, with a short visual metaphor — chat bubble, robot arm, calendar, empty inbox.
scenes.caption_overlay: The timeline is a cliff. Most people are still running.

scenes.voiceover: The people who thrive won't fight AI. They'll become the layer between AI and the world. That skill is learnable.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up face, direct eye contact, calm but intense. Slight lean-in on the word learnable. No cuts — sustained gaze creates intimacy and trust.
scenes.caption_overlay: This is not doom. This is a window. It's closing fast.

scenes.voiceover: Millions will wake up in 2026 and realize they missed the window. You're watching this before it closes. What happens next?
scenes.visual_description: Exact same black screen and white bold text as scene 1 — but now the final phrase is YOU DECIDE flashing in gold. Creates visual loop recognition.
scenes.caption_overlay: Watch again. You'll catch what you missed.

hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using the 'This changes everything' format around GPT-4 launch and Sam Altman congressional hearing clips each exceeded 15M–40M views on TikTok in 2023. The formula: alarming opening stat + credible source drop + personal stakes = sustained watch time.
hook_test.why_it_works: Opens with a future-tense personal threat (career gone), immediately grounds it with a credible institutional source, then escalates to a hidden timeline the viewer feels they are racing against. The loop ending rewards rewatches and signals algorithm-friendly completion rate.
